topStories.headline: Ellis County Lifts Burn Ban After Three-Month Restriction
topStories.dek: Commissioners' Court voted October 13 to rescind the county-wide ban first imposed in July.
topStories.body:
The Ellis County Commissioners' Court voted at its Tuesday, October 13, 2026 meeting to rescind the county-wide burn ban that had been in place since July 21, 2026. The county's official website announced the change as effective immediately, confirming that Ellis County is no longer under a burn ban — a restriction that had applied to all unincorporated areas of the county, including rural stretches around Ennis, Ferris, Palmer, and Italy.

The Commissioners' Court had originally voted to impose the burn ban at its July 21, 2026 meeting during a period of elevated fire risk tied to high temperatures and dry conditions across North Texas. The ban remained in effect for nearly three months before Tuesday's vote to lift it.

Residents planning any outdoor burning are reminded that local regulations still apply even when a county-wide ban is not active. Questions about proper burning procedures and regulations can be directed to the Ellis County Fire Marshal's Office at 972-825-5555.

topStories.headline: Ennis Auto & Truck Parts Named 2026 Texas Auto Recycler of the Year
topStories.dek: The Texas Automotive Recyclers Association honored the family-owned Roberts family business for its lasting impact on the industry.
topStories.body:
The Texas Automotive Recyclers Association recognized Ennis Auto & Truck Parts as the 2026 Auto Recycler of the Year, honoring the Roberts family and their entire team for the lasting impact they continue to make in Ennis, across Texas, and throughout the automotive recycling industry. The award was reported by the Ellis County Press on October 7, 2026.

Ennis Auto & Truck Parts, located at 3511 Ensign Rd., has operated on the southwest side of the city since 1978, when founder Byron Roberts opened the business — originally called Ennis Auto Salvage and Used Cars — on a 100-acre tract of land. The company specializes in recycled OEM auto parts, aftermarket and remanufactured components, and auto glass services, and ships parts nationwide. It holds a Green Vehicle Disposal (GVD) certification reflecting its commitment to environmentally responsible recycling practices.

The TARA honor adds to a legacy spanning nearly five decades of serving Ellis County and surrounding communities.

topStories.headline: Ennis Lions at 2-0 in District Play, Host Burleson Tonight
topStories.dek: Coming off a 500-yard offensive showing against Corsicana, the Lions take the field at home Friday evening while area volleyball teams enter a critical playoff stretch.
topStories.body:
The Ennis Lions carry a 2-0 district record into tonight's home game against Burleson, kicking off at 7:00 p.m. on Friday, October 16. The strong district start followed a dominant 42-23 victory over previously undefeated Corsicana on September 26, in which the Lions rolled up 500 yards of total offense — a performance that head coach Don Drake told the Ennis Daily News gave him valuable insights into his team.

The Lions had a bye in Week 6 before returning to action at Joshua on October 8. Tonight's home contest at 7:00 p.m. gives Ennis a chance to extend their district lead heading into the back half of the regular season.

Also in local fall sports, three area volleyball programs — Ennis, Italy, and Avalon — remain in contention for state playoff berths as the regular season nears its end around October 23. The Ennis Daily News reported that the next three weeks are critical for the Lions, Gladiators, and Eagles.

moreNews.headline: Super Bueno Mexican Grocery on Track to Open at 1205 W. Ennis Ave. by November
moreNews.body: A Super Bueno grocery and convenience store is under construction at 1205 W. Ennis Ave., according to Texas Department of Licensing and Regulation (TDLR) records filed by Super Bueno Ennis LLC in April 2026. The build-out covers approximately 20,000 square feet of leased space at an estimated value of $800,000, with a projected completion date of November 30, 2026. Super Bueno's existing location in Mount Pleasant, Texas operates as a Mexican grocery and restaurant offering fresh produce, marinated meats, and ready-to-eat meals. The project is privately funded.
moreNews.sourceName: Texas Department of Licensing and Regulation
